_comment: CasePal canonical structured-output schema for the Extraction Agent (Lab 1 onwards) and the Recommendation Agent (Lab 4). Referenced by content/labs/lab-01.md. Keep enums in sync with content/prompts/test-prompts.json.
name: casepal_case_intake

case_id.description: Echo of the input case ID (e.g. MDR-2026-0117).

applicant.description: Manufacturer / MAH / distributor name as submitted.

documents_present.description: Document codes present in the dossier (see references/dossier-structure-overview.md for canonical codes).

documents_missing_for_class.description: Document codes REQUIRED for the declared class but ABSENT. Compared against SOP-01.

router_choice.description: The model actually used by model-router (e.g. 'gpt-5-mini' or 'gpt-5') - populated automatically.

recommendation_schema._comment: Used by the Lab 4 orchestrator's synthesised output.

recommendation.description: The recommended action. reject is only used for repeat-cycle failures - see SOP-04. needs_review means CasePal defers to the reviewer without a specific recommendation.

confidence.description: How confident CasePal is in the recommendation. Anything below 0.7 must be flagged for reviewer attention.

supporting_evidence.description: Document IDs and SOP references that ground the recommendation. Never invent.

rationale.description: One-paragraph plain-English rationale. Never contains a binding regulatory statement.

draft_communication.description: Optional draft RFI or condition letter. Only populated when the Comms Drafter specialist runs.
